domains.title: GPU: Maxwell shader ISA

explicit_failures: %s of size %d (only 32-bit integer forms are translated)
%s op %d (CAS and float forms are not translated)
IDP is not translated (integer dot product exists from SM 6.0 only; Maxwell SM 5.x has none)
IMADSP is not translated (multiply-add with sub-word operand selectors: compilers emit XMAD instead)
OUT: geometry shader output is not supported (Metal has no geometry stage)
TXA is not translated (texture attribute query: no application shader uses it)
VABSDIFF4 is not translated (four-lane byte absolute difference: no application shader uses it)
atoms op %d (CAS and float forms are not translated)
bindless texture handle is not a constant buffer load
indexed attribute load outside the vertex and fragment stages
shared memory (LDS/STS) outside a compute shader
shared memory atomic outside a compute shader
shared memory of %u bytes exceeds Metal's 32 KB threadgroup limit
surface access (opcode %03x: SUATOM.CAS, SUCLAMP-class helpers and other variants) is not translated
texture gather with per-texel offsets (PTP: Metal needs constant offsets)
texture gather with reserved offset mode
tld4s with both a depth reference and offsets
txd of a 1D texture (Metal has no 1D gradients)
